payload.claim: No test in this diff (or anywhere in the suite) calls `describe()` on an `Agent` with `bounded=True`. Every other new render/behaviour this spec adds has a witness — the persisted `bounded`/`original_chars`/`line` fields are checked by `test_a_bounded_agent_event_says_it_was_bounded` — but the docstring's promised rendering (`agent: (bounded, N chars) <line, cut again to 160>`) is only asserted in prose, never in code. Truncating the display slice from `[:160]` to `[:16]`, or dropping `original_chars` from the message entirely, would keep every test in the diff green because none of them invoke `describe()` on a bounded event; `saffron watch`, the one consumer of this branch, would silently misreport a bounded event with no gate or test to catch it.
